__meta__.name: BMG · Cost Hypothesis
__meta__.description: Tests the hypothesis that 2-year (esp. public) students pay more for course materials. Top tile: per-section required/owned/optional cost medians by institution class (control x 2yr/4yr x A/B set) — directional, across each class's own course mix. Bottom tile: the Top-125 ISBN extract (one row per section-adoption of the 125 most-common ISBNs, with is_supply + full pricing) — the same-item cut that removes course-mix confounds. All *_cost columns are (min+max)/2 summaries, NOT arithmetic means. Supplies (#36) are excluded from the class cost medians; is_supply flags them in the Top-125 extract. Enrollment-weighted cost comparison is a held follow-up (uses master_section.enrollment_assigned).
